entities.summary: The St. Matthew Cathedral Also São Mateus Cathedral Is a Catholic church located in the municipality of São Mateus and is a reference in modern religious art in Brazil. It has in its interior impressionist paintings by Claudio Pastro, renowned artist of sacred art. St. Matthew Cathedral, São Mateus is a church building in Americas, established in 1987.
